qa_pairs.question: How do users launch interactive applications on the Open OnDemand platform?
qa_pairs.answer: To launch an interactive application on Open OnDemand, users must navigate to the 'Interactive Apps' tab and select the desired application from the drop-down menu. This will then direct them to a job submission page.

qa_pairs.question: What job parameters can be configured when submitting an interactive application on Open OnDemand?
qa_pairs.answer: When submitting an interactive application on Open OnDemand, users can choose job parameters such as the length of the job in hours, the number of cores, the amount of memory to allocate (in GB), and specific GPU resources.

qa_pairs.question: Which specific GPU profile is available for interactive applications on Open OnDemand, and what are its specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Currently, for interactive applications on Open OnDemand, only the 'h100_1.10' Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) profile is available. This profile provides 10GB of memory and 1/8 of the compute power of a full NVIDIA H100 GPU.
